PowerShiftDescription.dexterity: Dexterity: Dodging, Speed defense rolls, movement, acrobatics, gymnastics, initiative.
PowerShiftDescription.flight: Flight*: Can fly as fast as a regular human’s ground speed; not particularly maneuverable; can carry a creature of your size or smaller.
PowerShiftDescription.healing: Healing*: One extra one-action recovery each day.
PowerShiftDescription.increasedRange: Increased Range*: Increases the range of one ability; touch or immediate becomes short, short becomes long, long becomes very long.
PowerShiftDescription.intelligence: Intelligence: Intellect defense; all knowledge skills, science skills, and crafting skills.
PowerShiftDescription.power: Power: Effects and damage of one of your character abilities, but not attack rolls with it.
PowerShiftDescription.prodigy: Prodigy*: Trade one of your tier 1 abilities for a tier 2 focus ability, or trade two tier 1 abilities for a tier 3 focus ability. (This skips earlier abilities in your focus flowchart.)
PowerShiftDescription.resilience: Resilience: Blocking, Might defense rolls, tasks requiring hardiness and endurance.
PowerShiftDescription.savant: Savant: Two specific skills (other than an attack skill, a defense skill, or a character ability that requires an attack roll), such as history, perception, or charm. You can assign this shift to an ability that treats your roll as a minimum number, such as Incredible Instinct.
PowerShiftDescription.singleAttack: Single Attack: Attack rolls and damage for one specific kind of attack, such as pistols, punches, swords, or an attack special ability like laser eyes or a psychic blast.
PowerShiftDescription.strength: Strength: Athletics, noncombat strength rolls, melee damage, thrown weapon damage.

Recovery.RemovesMinorAndModerate: Removes all minor wounds and all but one moderate wound, if any.

ShieldAbility.LandsImmediate: The shield is not in hand. After a failed catch, Bouncing Shield lands within immediate range. Retrieve it before using it again.
ShieldAbility.LandsShort: The shield is not in hand. After a failed catch, it most likely lands a short distance away. Retrieve it before using it again.
ShieldAbility.RangeConfirmed: The targets are within the required range
ShieldAbility.RangeHint: For attacks, confirm melee reach or short throwing range. Target order is attack order; Bouncing Shield permits the third target to be the first target again.
ShieldAbility.ResourcesConfirm: Confirm that the required resources and crafting skill or outside arrangements have been provided. Hidden Shield repair takes about one day; an Unyielding Shield replacement takes 1d6 days of concerted effort. The CRD gives no fixed resource price, so this requires adjudication.
ShieldAbility.StaleCatch: The retained roll succeeded, but this catch's consequences can no longer be confirmed automatically. Check the shield's current location and any point-cost refund with the GM.
ShieldAbility.TurnLossPending: Unyielding Shield survived a major wound. Your next turn is lost unless the GM chooses an intrusion instead. The combat tracker skips that turn automatically; outside combat, acknowledge the lost turn here.
ShieldAbility.TurnLost: The next turn was lost because of Unyielding Shield.
ShieldAbility.WorkCompletedConfirm: Confirm that the required repair or replacement work has actually been completed. Its game-time deadline must also have elapsed.
